'''Conductive circuits''' were used in [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]] to carry the ultrasonic charge generated by the [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic vibration generator]] to the [[power tip]]. Layered conductive circuits lined the interior of the force pike along the weapon's shaft.<ref name="EGWT" />
